name: Regular Meeting of the Parks and Recreation Commission
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  (562) 865-6262

  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 25, 2023
  6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the Parks and Recreation Commission is asked to fill out a
speaker card and give that card to staff prior to the commencement of the meeting. Public
comments may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 4:00
pm on the date of the meeting. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public submits a speaker
card for an item on the agenda, the public comment will be given when the Commission
addresses the item. Public comments for items not listed on the agenda will be heard at this
time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the Commission is prohibited from taking action
on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the matter to staff or to a subsequent
meeting.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES
Adopt minutes from the following meeting: Wednesday, July 26, 2023 – Regular Meeting

NEW BUSINESS

  1.  Recap of 2023 International Street Fair and Diversity Festival
  2.  Update on Mini-Pitch Rink Project
  3.  L.A. County Supervisor Hahn secures $1.2 million for Park Improvements
  4.  Facility Repairs & Maintenance Updates
  5.  New and upcoming programming/events for Winter 2023

STAFF UPDATES

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
Next Regular Parks and Recreation Commission Meeting - Wednesday, January 24, 2024,
at 6:00 P.M.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
